title: Catholics in Latin America generally have positive views of Pope Leo
summary_en: In six Latin American countries surveyed, most Catholics view Pope Leo XIV favorably, though his ratings trail those Pope Francis received early in his papacy.
title_cn: Catholics in Latin America generally have positive views of Pope Leo

title: Most U.S. Catholics view Pope Leo favorably; many think Trump has been too critical of him
summary_en: About eight-in-ten U.S. Catholics view Pope Leo XIV favorably, though opinions on the tension between Leo and President Trump split sharply along party lines.
title_cn: Most U.S. Catholics view Pope Leo favorably; many think Trump has been too critical of him
